synergistic systems of a neutral and acidic extractant may be used to extract Eu3+ and separate it from Am3+ via a simplified processing scheme.

the hydrogen bond may play an important role in the extraction and separation process, and the extraction and separation performance may be tuned via the hydrogen bond strength between neutral and acid extractants.
